scope_violations.description: POST handler return statement changed from plain object to Response.json() wrapper. This is a functional change to a write-path handler during a read-only migration phase. The wrapper (withEnforcementFull) and auth logic remain correct, but the response shape mutation is out of scope for X2B Lane 2 (read-only handler migrations).
scope_violations.impact: POST behavior altered - may affect downstream callers expecting plain object serialization vs explicit Response.json(). Not backwards incompatible (Next.js handles both), but represents undocumented scope creep.
scope_violations.required_action: DOCUMENT - No revert needed (Response.json is correct for Next.js), but violation should be noted in acceptance decision.

requires_revert_or_followup.reason: Response.json() wrapper is technically more correct for Next.js route handlers. While this represents a scope violation (POST handler touched during GET-only phase), the change is benign and improves code consistency. No revert needed, but violation noted.
